name: obstacles

Row1: same overturned empty wooden carriage, broken axle, two large wheels, scattered timber, purple torn canopy, pumpkin cargo; four damage states intact obstruction, cracked, breaking apart with loose timbers, low collapsed wreckage. The first three retain a broad climbable top around chest-height of a small witch heroine. No horse or people. Row2: same stack of wooden crates and barrel with Halloween garland, four damage states intact climbable stack, cracked, splintering, low rubble. Row3: same fallen wooden beam resting on masonry and broken fence, four states intact low climbable barricade, cracked, breaking, small ruins. Every complete object inside its own equal cell with transparent gutters. Keep the same scale through the four states of an object.

name: baker-throw
prompt: Edit reference character into an EIGHT-pose throw-and-retreat animation sprite atlas, FOUR columns TWO rows, transparent background. Preserve this exact baker man identity, same face/head size, cap, moustache, blue vest, cream shirt, white apron, brown trousers and boots. He now faces RIGHT and defends fleeing villagers while backing LEFT. No bread basket; hands free. Sequential poses: 0 frightened ready stance, 1 reaches belt for a stone, 2 holds small stone near chest, 3 draws throwing hand far behind head, 4 accelerates arm forward, 5 RELEASE pose with EMPTY throwing hand extended toward right, 6 follows through retreating left, 7 regains running stance. Do NOT draw a flying stone or any projectile outside his hand. Natural grounded legs, identical body and head scale across all eight poses. Full painted shaded cartoon finish identical to reference, no tiny shrinking body to fit raised arm, no ground shadow, no effects or background. Exact eight cels, four columns two rows.

name: blacksmith-sprint
prompt: Replace this walking/jogging animation with a frantic EIGHT-frame SPRINT to LEFT. FOUR columns TWO rows, transparent background. Exact same blacksmith identity and clothing: burly dark-skinned man, curly black hair, full beard, red rolled-sleeve shirt, tan apron, dark pants, brown boots, hammer on belt. He is TERRIFIED and fleeing fast: eyebrows raised, mouth open, torso leans forward about 30 degrees throughout, fists pump vigorously at shoulder/hip level, apron and sleeves trail right. Long bent-knee running strides and clearly visible airborne phases with BOTH boots off the ground in poses3 and7. Far more urgent than strolling. Complete alternating cycle: near leg forward contact0, compress1, far knee passes high forward2, far flight3, far leg forward/near leg BACK on RIGHT4, compress5, near knee passes high forward6, near flight7. Follow the guide rhythm, do not repeat same leg leading all eight cels. Same face size, hip registration and painterly shaded cartoon finish. No ground, detached pieces, motion lines, text, shadow or background.
